main_text.p: populos, eosque circumscriben- dos, sive Papa illud imperium obducat mendacio, sive veritate fucet: eadem & pari fraude per tectorium vel hujus vel illius, manente & circumscribente Reges & populos.

Antequam finio debeo examini subjicere aliquot stricturas viri reverendi (cui sepositi Epistolam,) in opus meum, ut infirmet quod ubique dico, ad casum Papalis imperii, pompâ, robore & divitiis fulgentis, quibus authoritas conciliatur Romanensi Religioni, hanc cadere debere; affert exemplum Græcorum & Henrici VIII. Angliæ Regis; hoc retinente Religionem Romanam post abactum Papale imperium; illis non abeuntibus à Romanensibus erroribus quibusdam; quibus ta-men

page.notes: Printing is partly faint; "sepositi" in the text may read "seposui" (the line is "cui sepofui"), copied as printed as far as legible. The ornament and stray marks along the margins and the Google digitiser stamp at lower right are not transcribed.
